description: This file implements the OCIContainer class, which manages the lifecycle and registration of an OCI container plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes initialization, deinitialization, and notification handling, and defines the service name and metadata.

classes.name: OCIContainer
classes.description: Represents the OCI container plugin, managing its lifecycle, registration, and notifications within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: OCIContainer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the OCIContainer instance and sets the singleton pointer.

methods.name: ~OCIContainer
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the OCIContainer instance and resets the singleton pointer.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the OCIContainer with the provided service, sets up notifications, and registers the plugin.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and releases the service.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with the service name.
